question: Does refusing a buy unless the desk's own live %R lines are still rising right now (fast pitch > 0, slow pitch > 0, and the slow pitch not lower than a minute earlier) make the desk's trades more profitable per trade than the current desk, and more than refusing the same share of arms at random?
operator_sentence: Operator 2026-10-27: 'Preregister a replay test of a slope-now gate on the desk's own live pitch: refuse a buy unless fast pitch > 0 and slow pitch > 0 and the slow pitch is not falling vs one minute earlier; in the late-gates harness, against the current desk and a matched random refusal.'
registered_at: 2026-10-27 evening ET, before any variant of this study is run or read.
origin: 10/27 losses reviewed with the desk's logged api/state values: HOOD 13:00 (fast pitch +23.2 -> +7.9, slow +7.3 -> +2.0 in the minute before the buy, -35 bp) and ENPH 14:04 (slow pitch +0.1 a minute earlier, -19 bp) were bought as the climb ended; both live gates (wr_trend_min_rise 15 over ~10 min; 5m slow veto over 5 min) look back 5-10 minutes and pass a line that rose earlier and is flattening now. The pitch fields (pitch_record, ai_entry_watch.py ~16498, live since e99a2662 on 10/26) are display-only; should_arm_buy does not read them.
prior: Mixed. On 10/27's 22 buys with logged pitch, slow pitch >= +2 at the buy: 11 trades -12.5 bp; flattening 0..+2: 7 trades +8.3 bp; turning down: 4 trades +7.8 bp; the worst loser (IONQ 10:08, -63 bp) had fast +15.9 and slow +3.8, i.e. would have PASSED this gate. %R timing variants have been ~random so far (pitch studies 10/27). Prior lift 0 +- 3 bp.

gate.knob: NEW ai_watch_slope_now_gate (default false = off, live unchanged), checked in should_arm_buy next to the 5m veto and the Leg-1 gate, on every arm check.
gate.rule: Refuse with reason 'slope_not_rising' unless ALL of: indicator pctr_fast_pitch > 0, pctr_slow_pitch > 0, and pctr_slow_pitch >= pctr_slow_pitch_prev. Values as stamped by pitch_record at that moment (points per minute, rounded to 0.1).
gate.missing: PRIMARY is the rule as stated: a missing pctr_fast_pitch, pctr_slow_pitch or pctr_slow_pitch_prev REFUSES (reason 'slope_unknown'). Declared: on 10/27 live, fast pitch was present on 62% of live %R readings and the previous slow pitch on 59%, so this gate also refuses names without a pitch history (recently seated, or source just switched). Information variant SLOPE_OPEN: missing values do not refuse (only present values are tested).
gate.also: A new decision-ledger field set on arm rows: pctr_fast_pitch, pctr_slow_pitch, pctr_slow_pitch_prev (values as read), so live and replay can be compared. Default behavior unchanged.

variants.REF: The current desk: the day's recorded config with the 10/27 regime pinned (late_gates_run.PIN values: presquare_only true, Leg-1 OFF, ai_max_positions 5, ai_max_position_pct 20, ai_risk_pct 1.0, ai_watch_min_price 20, ai_position_slot_equity 60), the two live gates at their 10/27 values (wr_trend_min_rise 15, wr_slow_5m_veto true, min_pitch 0), ai_watch_slope_now_gate false.
variants.SLOPE_OPEN: Information: REF + the gate with missing values not refusing.
variants.RAND_k (k=1,2,3): REF + ai_watch_wr_rand_refuse_share = s, salt 'SN-k' (the salted wr_rand knob, 21e6f763), s = that session's max(0, 1 - n(SLOPE)/n(REF)) (two-pass).
variants.REF_DUP: REF run twice on the first, middle and last session (determinism).

fidelity_gate: Before any variant: replay 2026-10-27 as REF with REPLAY_KEEP_WORK=1. For each live buy that day with a logged pitch in api/state within 10 s before the fill (22 buys), match the replay's arm row for the same symbol within 90 s and compare the three gate inputs: the gate's pass/refuse decision must agree on >= 80% of matched buys, and >= 15 buys must match; also print the share of replay arm rows with each pitch field present vs live (62% / 59%). If it fails, SLOPE is NOT TESTABLE IN REPLAY and nothing is scored.
harness: late_gates exactly: tools/replay_session.py, --start 09:00 --end 15:50 --step 2.0 --engine recorded --exits live --live-staleness, paint on, one pinned --sha (the commit that adds the knob and the ledger fields); outputs ~/replay_runs/slope_now/DAY-VAR.json; costing = full SIP spread at entry; repriced check at the SIP 1m close of the entry minute; open_at_end marked at the SIP 15:49 close; classes same / delayed / removed / new vs REF; a session needs >= 5 REF trades; an identical session is scored with its computed lift (0).
sessions: Every recorded session with a wire recording, 2026-09-28 onward (20 at registration, through 10/27), plus forward sessions to a cap of 40. Halves by count in date order. Runs only after the late_gates primary and info phases have finished on the mini (Alpaca budget, one batch at a time).
statistic: Per session: lift_ref = mean net(SLOPE) - mean net(REF); lift_rand = mean net(SLOPE) - mean over k of mean net(RAND_k), valid when the seed-averaged RAND count is within +-15% of SLOPE's; bp per trade, sessions equal-weighted, t = std_scorer.day_stat.
power: MDE per half = 3.08 x max(sd_session(RAND avg - REF), sd_session(MDE1 - REF)) / sqrt(sessions in the half). Floors per half: >= 10 scored sessions, MDE <= 6 bp; else UNDERPOWERED (no means); at the 40-session cap UNDERPOWERED = FAIL. The REF_DUP difference, if > 1 bp/trade on any duplicated session, raises the pass bar by that amount.
pass: lift_ref >= +3 bp/trade (plus any REF_DUP penalty) with t >= 2.0 over all scored sessions; lift_ref > 0 in BOTH halves; lift_rand > 0 with t >= 2.0 (dropped only if both the net refused share and the removed share are < 0.05, as late_gates amended_2 #14); the repriced lift_ref >= +3 with t >= 2.0 and > 0 in both halves; >= 300 REF trades and >= 150 SLOPE trades. The verdict also states whether SLOPE's own mean net is > 0 (profitable) or only less negative.
fail: lift_ref <= 0 in either half is FAIL regardless of t; anything else short of PASS is FAIL (or UNDERPOWERED / NOT TESTABLE).
information_only: SLOPE_OPEN vs REF (the gate without the missing-pitch refusal).
Refusal counts by reason: slope_not_rising vs slope_unknown; share of arm checks refused.
Class split (same / delayed / removed / new) with mean net per class; median delay of delayed entries.
Trades per session and opens per 10 minutes, REF vs SLOPE.
Drop top 3 sessions and top 5 names from lift_ref; entries before 11:00 vs after.
if_pass: result-skeptic Mode 3, then the operator decides on a live switch (after the close).
if_fail: Keep the gate off. Record that a 'still rising now' rule does not separate winners from losers on the desk's own lines, so the topping entries need a different explanation (name selection or exits).
no_retuning: No threshold (e.g. slow pitch >= +1, fast-only) is scored as primary.
script: Knob, ledger fields, runner tools/studies/slope_now_run.py and scorer tools/studies/slope_now_read.py (reusing late_gates_run / late_gates_read) are written after this file is committed and after a result-skeptic READY; they may not change anything above.
multiplicity: One primary. Every information line has no pass.

amended.when: 2026-10-27 ~19:30 ET, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST (9 findings), before any code or replay.
amended.1_fidelity: Replaces fidelity_gate. Replay 2026-10-27 as REF (REPLAY_KEEP_WORK=1). For EVERY replay arm check 09:30-15:50, match the nearest live ai_reports/entry_watch_state.json snapshot row (state_snapshots.jsonl.gz) for the same symbol within 5 s. GATED, all required: (a) presence share of each of pctr_fast_pitch, pctr_slow_pitch, pctr_slow_pitch_prev in replay within +-10 points of live; (b) sign agreement >= 80% on each of the three conditions (fast > 0, slow > 0, slow >= slow_prev) over checks where both have values; (c) median |replay - live| <= 1.0 point/min for fast and slow pitch; (d) the gate's refusal count in replay is 50-200% of the rule applied to the live snapshots at the matched checks. Fail = SLOPE NOT TESTABLE IN REPLAY, nothing scored. The new ledger fields (pctr_fast_pitch, pctr_slow_pitch, pctr_slow_pitch_prev, pctr_pitch_ts) are written on EVERY arm row regardless of the knob.
amended.2_staleness: pitch_record also stamps pctr_pitch_ts (the time the pitch was computed). The gate treats a pitch older than 12 s at the check as missing.
amended.3_exists: New information variant EXISTS: refuse only when any of the three pitch fields is missing or stale (no slope test). Pre-registered wording: if EXISTS's lift_ref is >= SLOPE's, the verdict reads 'the effect is the pitch-history requirement, not the slope'. Also reported: SLOPE refusals by %R level band (a %R pinned at 0 has pitch 0 and is refused).
amended.4_controls: New per-check random control CRAND_k (k=1,2,3): a NEW knob ai_watch_slope_rand_share with salt 'SC-k' refuses an arm check when sha256(salt|symbol|day|floor(ts/30)) < share; share = SLOPE's per-check refusal rate among checks that passed every other gate (two-pass; counted from SLOPE's ledger). CRAND is the delay-matched leg: lift_rand = mean net(SLOPE) - mean over k of mean net(CRAND_k). The episode-level RAND_k (wr_rand) stays as information. A session where the seed-averaged CRAND count is not within +-15% of SLOPE's has no lift_rand that session (counted); if more than a third of scored sessions lose lift_rand this way, the verdict cannot PASS.
amended.5_sessions: Recorded sessions with a wire recording: 2026-09-28, 09-29, 09-30, 10-01, 10-02, 10-05, 10-06, 10-07, 10-08, 10-09, 10-12, 10-13, 10-14, 10-15, 10-16, 10-19, 10-20, 10-21, 10-22, 10-23, 10-26, 10-27 (22). 10-27 is the fidelity day and the source of the HOOD/ENPH examples and the prior table: it is replayed but NOT scored. Scored: the other 21, plus forward sessions to the 40 cap.
amended.6_pins: Every variant also pins the 10/27 values of the knobs that decide whether a pitch exists: ai_watch_poll_sec 10.0, ai_watch_engine_exh_max_age_sec 8.0, ai_watch_exhaustion_engine_only true, ai_watch_stream_bars_live true. Per session the replay REF pitch presence share is printed; a session more than 15 points off 10/27's replay presence share is excluded (counted). Forward sessions' recorded config_fp differences from 10/27 are listed.
amended.7_power: Unchanged; declared likely UNDERPOWERED (live 10/27 had ~44 checks that passed every gate).
amended.pass_update: In 'pass', lift_rand means the CRAND (per-check, delay-matched) leg.
